image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black audio cassette tape resting on a white surface. The cassette features a transparent window revealing the internal spools and magnetic tape. An orange label with handwritten text is visible on the top face. There are distinct orange horizontal stripes across the front. The plastic casing shows signs of wear or texture, and there appear to be some smudges or artifacts on the surface.

The molded details near the bottom left corner are indistinct and blurry. The expected sharp edges of the plastic molding are soft and undefined, suggesting a failure to render fine mechanical details.

The geometry of the internal spools seems slightly inconsistent with the external casing perspective. The right spool appears somewhat distorted and less circular than the left, which may indicate minor geometric warping.
